title: Immersions: base change and finite type
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be an immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion] (a closed immersion $Z\to U$ followed by an open immersion $U\to X$ [def-weil-open-immersion]). (1) For every morphism of schemes $g:X'\to X$ [def-pc-scheme] the projection $Z\times_XX'\to X'$ from the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] is an immersion (Stacks Schemes, Lemma 01JY). (2) $j$ is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] (Stacks Morphisms, Lemma 01T5).
